# Yantraloka // AI Prompt Archive

> Curated open archive of 15,600+ generative AI prompt formulas with taxonomy categorization and dynamic argument substitution for Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, and DALL-E.

## Overview
- Project Name: Yantraloka
- Total Prompt Formulas: 15,601+
- Dynamic Arguments: 16,045+
- Curated Taxonomy Categories: 20
- Website: https://yantraloka.com

## Prompt Structure
Prompts are structured instruction formulas for generative image models. Dynamic formulas contain editable token arguments formatted as:
`{argument name="<argument_name>" default="<default_value>"}`

When rendered for model execution, all argument placeholders are substituted with user-provided or default values to produce clean, unannotated prompt text.

Each taxonomy category groups prompt formulas by visual style and subject matter:

- Portrait (2,400+ prompts): https://yantraloka.com/tag/portrait

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- Robots Policy: https://yantraloka.com/robots.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://yantraloka.com/sitemap.xml
- Single Prompt JSON: https://yantraloka.com/api/prompts/{id}
- Filtered Prompts Search: https://yantraloka.com/api/prompts?q={query}&tag={slug}&page={page}
- Taxonomy Tags JSON: https://yantraloka.com/api/tags
